per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall respond to routine interactions (e.g., search or update) within a couple of seconds, and complete large schedule-building operations within approximately 30 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The response time of general student management tasks shall take no longer than 5 seconds and the response time of schedule generation shall take no longer than 30 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall be available during business hours (approximately 09:00–17:00) with uptime of at least 95% during those hours.
The system shall support at least 10 concurrent users performing scheduling activities without performance degradation during peak morning periods.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall cater to 10 simultaneous users from 9am to 5pm.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall prevent conflicting assignments by performing pre-save validation and by blocking clearly invalid actions (hard stops) and presenting warnings with suggested fixes for borderline cases.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall have basic data integrity checking to reduce the possibility of incorrect or invalid data being introduced.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall enforce role-based access control so that program administrators have broad/full access while site coordinators and instructors only see information necessary for their roles (e.g., instructors see schedules and contact info but not full student files).
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Only authorized users shall have access to clinical site information.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall restrict access to sensitive student personal information and site internal notes so only authorized roles can view them.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: Only authorized users shall have access to students' personal information.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide integration capabilities with existing university systems (registrar, student records, learning platforms) to exchange basic information and avoid retyping.

The system shall validate data formats (e.g., dates) and business rules (e.g., shift within normal clinical hours, site accepts the program) and block or warn on invalid entries to prevent bad data from propagating.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall have basic data integrity checking to reduce the possibility of incorrect or invalid data being introduced.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide notifications via email as the baseline, in-app reminders while users are logged in, and optional SMS for urgent last-minute changes, with controls to limit what is sent to external sites versus internal staff.
The system shall implement automatic saving of edits and provide a mechanism to roll back changes (versioning/undo) and backups to recover lost or corrupted entries.

The system shall provide clear, inline warnings and error messages that explain issues and suggest fixes to help non-technical users avoid mistakes, minimizing the need for lengthy training or manuals.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All of the users shall be able to use the system after one day of training.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall be tested under realistic peak load scenarios (e.g., busy morning with ~10 concurrent users) to identify failures and ensure reliability under peak usage.
The system shall provide audit logging of changes and access so administrators can trace who made edits and when, aiding recovery and investigating mistakes.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall have basic data integrity checking to reduce the possibility of incorrect or invalid data being introduced.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall allow administrators to configure permissions and the level of information shared with external site contacts to avoid accidental disclosure (e.g., prevent sending full student spreadsheets externally).
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Only authorized users shall have access to clinical site information.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Training for end users shall consist of a short hands-on session plus a concise cheat sheet and follow-up support for the first week; long manuals should be avoided.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All of the users shall be able to use the system after one day of training.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall prioritize correctness (preventing scheduling conflicts and inaccurate assignments) over aesthetic features like dashboards and reports during initial rollout.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall help the user avoid making mistakes while scheduling classes and clinicals for the nursing students.'
